$comment: SaathiOS curated ECC profile. Vendor source is the PINNED, DISABLED ecc@ecc plugin cache. Synced components are gitignored; this manifest is the committed source of truth. Regenerate with scripts/ecc_profile_sync.sh.
rationale: The plugin registers all 448 components (~40.6k always-on tokens) and an unpinned chrome-devtools MCP. Disabled, it contributes zero context and zero MCP while remaining the pinned, updatable vendor source.

excluded.reason_orchestration: Duplicates SaathiOS mission and autonomous-loop machinery.
excluded.reason_offDomain: No SaathiOS relevance; pure context cost.
excluded.reason_languages: SaathiOS is Python/FastAPI plus a Next.js/React frontend.
excluded.reason_harness: harness-audit is a self-authored rubric whose top remediation is installing ECC; auto-update violates the manual-update rule.
excluded.reason_mcp: Unpinned `npx -y chrome-devtools-mcp@latest` with full control of a browser holding operator sessions. SaathiOS already has two reviewed browser surfaces.

notInstalled_availableOnDemand: Every other ECC component remains readable in the vendor root and can be added to this manifest and re-synced. Nothing was deleted upstream.

rulesCommonDropped.reason: common/ rule files are ALWAYS-loaded (no `paths:` frontmatter gate), unlike the language packs. agents.md and hooks.md describe an ECC component set this profile does not install (stale/CONFLICTING); git-workflow.md conflicts with SaathiOS git discipline in AGENTS.md; performance.md is model-selection advice; patterns.md is skeleton-project advice. Dropping them removes ~2.8k always-on tokens with no loss of a gate.
